name: raster_memory_time_ratio
code:
def raster_memory_time_ratio(p, hw, cfg) -> float:
    """DRAM time of (raster operand traffic + C write + split-K partials) over tensor-core time at the roofline ridge. Larger is worse."""
    gm, gn, z = math.ceil(p.M / cfg.tile_m), math.ceil(p.N / cfg.tile_n), max(1, cfg.split_k)
    ks = math.ceil(p.K / (cfg.tile_k * z)) * cfg.tile_k
    a, b = cfg.tile_m * ks * p.bytes_per_element, cfg.tile_n * ks * p.bytes_per_element
    s = int(cfg.ext.get("swizzle_n", 1) or 1)
    w = gn if cfg.ext.get("swizzle_type") == "horizontal" else (8 if s >= 8 and gn >= 6 else 4 if s >= 4 and gn >= 3 else 2 if s >= 2 and gn >= 2 else 1)
    f1 = min(1.0, hw.sm_count * max(1, cfg.max_blocks_per_sm) / (gm * gn * z))
    for v in [w]:
        v = min(v, gn)
        y, x = math.ceil(gn / v), gm * v
        ha = 1.0 if y == 1 else f1 + (1 - f1) * min(1.0, hw.l2_bytes / (gm * a + min(gn, v) * b))
        hb = 1.0 if v == 1 else f1 + (1 - f1) * min(1.0, hw.l2_bytes / (a + v * b))
        tr = z * (gm * (1 + (y - 1) * (1 - ha)) * a + gn * (1 + (gm - 1) * (1 - hb)) * b)
    e = p.M * p.N
    fx = 2.0 * (z - 1 if cfg.split_k_mode == "serial" else z) * e * p.acc_bytes_per_element if z > 1 else 0.0
    return (tr + e * p.bytes_per_element + fx) * hw.ridge_point / (2.0 * p.M * p.N * p.K)
rationale: t_mem / t_compute with t_mem = bytes / bandwidth and t_compute = 2MNK / peak, i.e. bytes * hw.ridge_point / 2MNK. Bytes are the raster-model operand traffic (see l2_raster_traffic_ratio) plus the C write and the split-K partial round trips (serial: 2(s-1)MN acc bytes, parallel: 2sMN). Above 1 the config is DRAM bound under its own launch order even when the shape's roofline says compute bound: that is the a6000 swizzle trap (6 MB L2, width-1 raster on an 8192-row grid). Pool note: Cross-tile roofline under the config's own raster (highest whole-shape Spearman of the ext set, 0.49). Use log2 of it; no gain on top of the time model + deficit in the surrogate (1.031 -> 1.034). raster_memory_excess = log2(max(1, this)) was dropped as derivable.

name: l2_locality_deficit
code:
def l2_locality_deficit(p, hw, cfg) -> float:
    """log2 of this raster's DRAM operand bytes over the best raster the kernel family can realise for the same tile and split (identity width 1/2/4/8 after the CUTLASS width rule, or horizontal). Zero for that best raster and on single-wave grids. Larger is worse."""
    gm, gn, z = math.ceil(p.M / cfg.tile_m), math.ceil(p.N / cfg.tile_n), max(1, cfg.split_k)
    ks = math.ceil(p.K / (cfg.tile_k * z)) * cfg.tile_k
    a, b = cfg.tile_m * ks * p.bytes_per_element, cfg.tile_n * ks * p.bytes_per_element
    s = int(cfg.ext.get("swizzle_n", 1) or 1)
    w = gn if cfg.ext.get("swizzle_type") == "horizontal" else (8 if s >= 8 and gn >= 6 else 4 if s >= 4 and gn >= 3 else 2 if s >= 2 and gn >= 2 else 1)
    f1 = min(1.0, hw.sm_count * max(1, cfg.max_blocks_per_sm) / (gm * gn * z))
    tl = []
    for v in [w] + [8 if u >= 8 and gn >= 6 else 4 if u >= 4 and gn >= 3 else 2 if u >= 2 and gn >= 2 else 1 for u in (1, 2, 4, 8)] + [gn]:
        v = min(v, gn)
        y, x = math.ceil(gn / v), gm * v
        ha = 1.0 if y == 1 else f1 + (1 - f1) * min(1.0, hw.l2_bytes / (gm * a + min(gn, v) * b))
        hb = 1.0 if v == 1 else f1 + (1 - f1) * min(1.0, hw.l2_bytes / (a + v * b))
        tr = z * (gm * (1 + (y - 1) * (1 - ha)) * a + gn * (1 + (gm - 1) * (1 - hb)) * b)
        tl.append(tr)
    return math.log2(tl[0] / min(tl))
rationale: Isolates the rasterization part of the L2 locality cost: the same gap model is run for every raster the kernel family can realise on this grid (identity widths 1/2/4/8 as CUTLASS clamps them to the grid, and the full-width horizontal band), and the feature is how many doublings of DRAM operand traffic this config's launch order costs over the best of them. Same tile, same split, different swizzle -> different value; a grid that fits in one wave or whose operands fit hw.l2_bytes gives 0 for all variants. Pool note: THE swizzle term: one flat positive weight, no gate. 0 on the best realisable raster and on single-wave grids, so it adds no offset between tiles. On top of the current-contract pool rule it takes surrogate 1.038 -> 1.031 (big 1.034 -> 1.010).

name: l2_wave_traffic_ratio
code:
def l2_wave_traffic_ratio(p, hw, cfg) -> float:
    """log2 of operand bytes under the synchronized-wave model (each wave of resident CTAs loads its distinct A and B slabs once, no reuse across waves) over compulsory bytes. Larger is worse."""
    gm, gn, z = math.ceil(p.M / cfg.tile_m), math.ceil(p.N / cfg.tile_n), max(1, cfg.split_k)
    ks = math.ceil(p.K / (cfg.tile_k * z)) * cfg.tile_k
    a, b = cfg.tile_m * ks * p.bytes_per_element, cfg.tile_n * ks * p.bytes_per_element
    s = int(cfg.ext.get("swizzle_n", 1) or 1)
    w = gn if cfg.ext.get("swizzle_type") == "horizontal" else (8 if s >= 8 and gn >= 6 else 4 if s >= 4 and gn >= 3 else 2 if s >= 2 and gn >= 2 else 1)
    f1 = min(1.0, hw.sm_count * max(1, cfg.max_blocks_per_sm) / (gm * gn * z))
    act = min(hw.sm_count * max(1, cfg.max_blocks_per_sm), gm * gn)
    v = min(w, gn)
    dm = min(gm, max(1.0, act / v))
    dn = min(gn, act, v * max(1.0, act / (gm * v)))
    tr = z * (gm * gn / act) * (dm * a + dn * b)
    return math.log2(max(1.0, tr / ((p.M + p.N) * p.K * p.bytes_per_element)))
rationale: The simple window form: the resident CTAs of one wave cover act/w rows of tiles and w columns (horizontal: act/gn rows of the whole width), so the wave's operand working set is (act/w)*tile_m*K + w*tile_n*K bytes (for act > gm*w: all gm rows and w*act/(gm*w) columns), loaded once per wave. Traffic over compulsory; 1 on single-wave grids. A lockstep-wave bound, kept to test against the launch-gap model. Pool note: Control model (lockstep waves). Neutral on top of the time model + deficit (1.031 -> 1.032); kept as the alternative cross-tile L2 term.
